description: Natural-prose candidate cases used only for dense screening and selector training. Keep separate from natural_heldout.json.

cases.evidence: The hydrology panel identified Cedar Spring as the preserve's dependable dry-season water source. Its recommendation followed two years of flow measurements and replaced an older emergency plan.
cases.needle: The hydrology panel identified Cedar Spring as the preserve's dependable dry-season water source.
cases.question: Question: What did the panel identify as the preserve's dependable dry-season water source? Answer with only its name.
distractors: Willow Pond supplies the visitor center during summer but is not classified as a dry-season source.
The emergency plan once listed North Well as a temporary backup.
Juniper Creek is monitored for habitat quality rather than water supply.

cases.evidence: According to the library history, the central reading room reopened on 12 September 1992. The renovation added fire protection while preserving the original oak tables.
cases.needle: According to the library history, the central reading room reopened on 12 September 1992.
cases.question: Question: On what date did the central reading room reopen? Answer with only the date.
distractors: The map room closed on 8 September 1991 for an unrelated ventilation project.
A ceremony planned for 3 August 1992 was postponed before the reading room opened.
The children's wing reopened on 19 October 1993.

cases.evidence: The county planning board selected the Alder Framework for evaluating hillside conservation grants. Reviewers favored its separate scores for erosion risk and community access.
cases.needle: The county planning board selected the Alder Framework for evaluating hillside conservation grants.
cases.question: Question: Which framework did the planning board select for evaluating hillside conservation grants? Answer with only its name.
distractors: The Birch Schedule governs inspection dates but does not evaluate grant proposals.
Consultants tested the Rowan Matrix and rejected its combined risk score.
The state office applies the Elm Standard to coastal projects.

cases.evidence: The maintenance specification requires alloy T-19 for the compressor's inner seal ring. Bench testing showed that the earlier P-6 ring expanded beyond tolerance.
cases.needle: The maintenance specification requires alloy T-19 for the compressor's inner seal ring.
cases.question: Question: Which alloy is required for the compressor's inner seal ring? Answer with only the alloy code.
distractors: Alloy P-6 appeared in the prototype seal and failed expansion testing.
The compressor housing uses alloy C-22 rather than the seal material.
Fasteners listed on the same order use alloy T-14.

cases.evidence: The Meridian parser saves its restart marker in var/meridian.state whenever a source bundle finishes. On launch, the recovery routine checks that file before opening the next bundle.
cases.needle: The Meridian parser saves its restart marker in var/meridian.state whenever a source bundle finishes.
cases.question: Question: Where does the Meridian parser save its restart marker? Answer with only the path.
distractors: Parser warnings are appended to logs/meridian.txt and cannot restart a job.
The legacy Delta loader uses var/delta.offset for a different format.
Temporary source fragments remain in cache/meridian until validation.

cases.evidence: The revised survey catalog names the reconciled western mosaic Meridian Sector 442. Earlier field notebooks divided the same sky region among two provisional entries.
cases.needle: The revised survey catalog names the reconciled western mosaic Meridian Sector 442.
cases.question: Question: What name does the revised catalog give the reconciled western mosaic? Answer with only the name.
distractors: Meridian Sector 424 is an eastern calibration field.
Western Mosaic B was a provisional notebook label that the catalog retired.
Meridian Sector 449 borders the mosaic but remains a separate entry.

cases.evidence: The summer harbor schedule assigns the Calypso ferry to pier 7 for all passenger departures. Freight vessels continue to use the adjacent service pier.
cases.needle: The summer harbor schedule assigns the Calypso ferry to pier 7 for all passenger departures.
cases.question: Question: Which pier is assigned to the Calypso ferry? Answer with only the pier number.
distractors: The freight vessel Mariner loads at pier 6.
A winter draft proposed pier 9 for Calypso but was not adopted.
Pier 4 remains reserved for harbor maintenance boats.

cases.evidence: The orchard trial selected the Solace pear for expanded planting in the upper terraces. It produced stable yields after two unusually cold springs.
cases.needle: The orchard trial selected the Solace pear for expanded planting in the upper terraces.
cases.question: Question: Which pear variety did the orchard trial select for expanded planting? Answer with only the variety.
distractors: The Marlow pear performed well in the lower field but was not expanded.
An early proposal recommended the Haven pear before winter damage was measured.
The orchard retained a small row of Crest pears for comparison.

cases.evidence: The facilities directory places the Cobalt imaging unit in room 214. Patients reach it through the north corridor beyond the main laboratory.
cases.needle: The facilities directory places the Cobalt imaging unit in room 214.
cases.question: Question: Which room contains the Cobalt imaging unit? Answer with only the room number.
distractors: Room 241 contains the older Amber scanner.
A draft directory incorrectly placed Cobalt in room 204.
Room 114 is used for equipment intake rather than imaging.

cases.evidence: The accession ledger stores the expedition photographs in the Finch archive box. The box also contains the photographer's route notes and exposure index.
cases.needle: The accession ledger stores the expedition photographs in the Finch archive box.
cases.question: Question: Which archive box contains the expedition photographs? Answer with only the box name.
distractors: The Heron box contains shipping receipts from the same expedition.
A temporary inventory sheet mistakenly referenced the Lark box.
The route maps are filed separately in the Kestrel cabinet.

cases.evidence: The coastal operations manual sets the Northwatch beacon to 88.4 megahertz during emergency drills. Operators verify the channel before each transmission test.
cases.needle: The coastal operations manual sets the Northwatch beacon to 88.4 megahertz during emergency drills.
cases.question: Question: What frequency does the manual specify for the Northwatch beacon? Answer with only the frequency.
distractors: The Southwatch beacon transmits routine notices at 87.9 megahertz.
An obsolete handbook listed 88.1 megahertz for Northwatch.
Portable harbor radios use 91.2 megahertz during maintenance.

cases.evidence: The greenhouse report identifies Maple as the controller responsible for the eastern irrigation loop. Its replacement battery was installed after the winter inspection.
cases.needle: The greenhouse report identifies Maple as the controller responsible for the eastern irrigation loop.
cases.question: Question: Which controller is responsible for the eastern irrigation loop? Answer with only its name.
distractors: Cedar controls ventilation in the western greenhouse.
A preliminary wiring plan assigned the eastern loop to Aspen.
Birch monitors temperature but does not operate irrigation.
